craftHeading: Care in the parts you see—and the parts you don't.
whoText: We work with homeowners, landlords, investors, property managers, businesses and commercial property owners
craftText:
With a family background centred around property investment, from renovating rental properties at the age of 16, then going into a carpentry apprenticeship. 

Ive seen and witnessed a lot. 

After witnessing some terrible work attitude and craftsmanship even on high end residential and commercial projects, I couldn't stand by and let others pull me down. 

I wanted to do work that genuinely cared about quality and service.
 
Working as though it was our own home and project. 
Making sure its done right even when no one sees it. 

I can guarantee that every project has every ounce of thought and effort put into it, that at the end of the day we always pack up with a good heart and our soul is more fulfilled knowing that our clients will be just as pleased as we are.

- Alex
heroIntro: We want ANDRO to be known for craftsmanship, quality and service
visionText: We want ANDRO to be known for craftsmanship, quality and service—not as a slogan, but in the way we communicate, plan and complete work. We value long-term relationships and the reassurance that comes from knowing who is looking after your property.
visionHeading: A business built on trust over time.
description: Learn about ANDRO Construction + Projects, an Auckland company established in 2020 and guided by craftsmanship, quality and service.
